summary_ja: 感応度を報告通貨で表示すること、及び独立したリスク管理部署が用いる商品価格・時価評価モデルに基づいて算出することを定める。
summary_en: Requires sensitivities to be expressed in the reporting currency and calculated on the basis of the product prices or valuation models used by the independent risk management unit.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall express the sensitivities for each risk class in the reporting currency.

The calculation of sensitivities shall be based on the product prices or mark-to-market valuation models used by the independent risk management unit to report the market risk equivalent amount or actual P&L to directors, etc.
